entrypoints.description: Storage-neutral typed reader is the semantic replay owner used by PostgreSQL, DuckDB and product-facing replay.
Storage-neutral orientation boundary exposes source-grounded catalog membership without moving catalog truth semantics into presentation.

Deterministic read-only projection turns one already-filtered point-in-time snapshot into flat entries, knowledge progression and Judgment-centered storylines without deciding visibility or adding epistemic records.
Researcher entry projection composes source-grounded industry membership with the existing typed snapshot at one shared knowledge cutoff and links subjects into trajectory replay.

extension_seams: Researcher-readable trajectory/table/graph views over an already-filtered typed snapshot.
New read-only CLI/API/UI projections that do not reimplement knowledge visibility.
Compose source-grounded catalog identity/membership through a typed read boundary while leaving membership truth and reconciliation in their existing owners.
Additional storage adapters implementing the same typed reader contracts.

guards.description: Integrated replay consumes the typed DuckDB reader rather than physical tables.
Hard smoke round-trips one typed timeline across PostgreSQL and DuckDB.
Presentation regression proves a related milestone stays indeterminate/not-comparable and is never narrated as realized.
Orientation contract proves a future-known membership and a future Outcome cannot cross the shared researcher knowledge cutoff.
Service-capable synthetic smoke proves grounded resolution-backed membership through PostgreSQL, the orientation adapter and the researcher CLI without creating real industry research data.
Service-capable regression exercises `longcycle research replay` at multiple historical cutoffs and verifies knowledge progression plus unchanged original Judgment content.

non_goals: Direct SQL as product replay semantics.
Creating new Fact/Judgment/Outcome or industry-membership truth records in presentation code.
Presentation code deciding its own Reality/Judgment/Outcome knowledge-cutoff eligibility.
Inferring value-chain role, participant importance, causality, consensus, controversy or unknowns from counts, filenames or co-occurrence.
Treating current catalog canonical names as historical-name replay.
Inferring causality, realization or success/failure beyond the stored Outcome semantics.
Rewriting an original Judgment because a later Outcome became visible.
purpose: Own storage-neutral reconstruction of what Reality, Judgment and Outcome records were knowable at a historical cutoff, plus deterministic researcher-readable projections over that filtered memory. This includes a bounded industry-entry projection that composes already-grounded catalog membership with the same typed memory cutoff, while source/catalog membership truth remains owned by existing Evidence/reconciliation semantics. Presentation never manufactures causality, importance, controversy, unknowns or historical labels.
revisit_when: Only replace if a stronger storage-neutral read contract preserves the same no-lookahead and typed Reality/Judgment/Outcome semantics while keeping researcher presentation downstream of knowledge-cutoff filtering and catalog membership authority outside presentation.
title: Typed point-in-time industrial-memory replay
